content.text: *Funct incont: ← physical or cog disability (delirium, dementia) w/ a norm GU system
Involuntary urinary leakage preceded by or accompanied by sudden urge to urinate
: detrusor muscle is stimulated by muscarinic acetylcholine receptors –
overactivity leads to uninhibited (involuntary) detrusor muscle contractions during bladder filling
increased age, idiopathic, bladder infection (cystitis), stones or tumor
increased urgency, frequency, small volume voids, nocturia
w/ an inability to make it to the bathroom in time
– timed frequent voiding, using a voiding diary to identify the shortest voiding intervals, decreased fluid intake
: avoid spicy foods, citrus fruit, chocolate, alcohol, & caffeine
anticholinergics, antispasmodics that also ↑ bladder capacity
– beta-3 agonist that causes bladder relaxation
– central & peripheral anticholinergic effect & alpha-adrenergic agonist (
bladder muscle relaxation, ↑ bladder outlet resistance, antispasmodic effect on detrusor muscle, ↑ urethral sphincter tone
Urinary retention & incomplete bladder emptying → involuntary urine leakage once the bladder = full (aka it overflows)
MC in neurological disorders or autonomic dysfun
– DM, MS, spinal injuries, spinal stenosis, periph neuropathy assoc w/ vit B12 deficiency
, uterine fibroids, pelvic organ prolapse, overcorrection of urethra from prior pelvic floor surg
loss of urine w/ ⍉warning (as in urge) or triggers (as in stress)
leakage or dribbling in the setting of incomplete bladder emptying, weak or intermittent urinary stream, hesitancy, freq, nocturia
– leakage often occurs w/ chgs in position
•Urodynamic testing to differentiate it from urethral obstruct in men
intermittent or indwelling cath first line
Involuntary leakage of urine that occurs once ↑ abd P (ex, exertion, coughing, laughing, sneezing) > urethral P & resistance or urine flow
MC type of incont in younger women
(ex, childbirth, surg, postmenopausal estrogen loss) – although rare in men,
may be assoc w/ stress incont
– insuff support from the pelvic floor musculature & the vaginal connective tissue to the urethra & bladder neck
•Cystoscopy and urodynamic testing to evaluate funct
urine leakage during times of ↑intra-abd P
(ex, coughing, laughing, sneezing, lifting heavy objects) –
there = NO urge to urinate prior to leakage
– initial tx of choice; Kegel supportive therapy includes supervised therapy, vaginal weighted cones or biofeedback; bladder training (ex, timed voidings);
topical estrogen for postmenopausal women w/ vaginal atrophy
– used in conjunction w/ pelvic floor exercises; protective garments & pads, wt loss, smoke cessation, & drinking smaller amounts of H2O throughout the day
– used if incomplete efficacy w/ lifestyle modifications & musc strengthening or situational stress incont
(higher success rates than conservative therapy); more rapid & definitive tx
